## Summary
<!-- Please describe what problems your PR addresses. -->

This fixes a few small issues on covered while working on larger refactors of O3.

* The logout spec now gets a session of its own so it doesn't race the shared auth store.
* O3-5982: `getTranslationOverrides()` always settles whereas previously it could hang indefinitely.
* O3-5975: `useConfig()` now uses only a single suspense promise per config id and drops it when it settles, so re-renders of the same component wait on the same promise. This promise now doesn't settle until the config does.
* Several scripts _here only_ depend on '^build' of the framework. This is correctly reflected in the turbo setup. This only applies to esm-core.
* The E2E scripts can now use `podman`
